## Specification

### Component: Animated counter

Numbers whose digits roll to their new value (NumberFlow-like), plus a count-up hook. No dependencies: Intl does the formatting, CSS does the motion.

#### Anatomy
```
<AnimatedNumber value format locale prefix suffix animateOnView>
  <span class="ui-number">
    <span class="ui-number-sr">$1,234.50</span>               plain text for assistive tech
    <span class="ui-number-visual" aria-hidden="true">
      <span class="ui-number-symbol">$</span>                 currency, separators, signs, % , K
      <span class="ui-number-digit">                          one line tall, clips its reel
        <span class="ui-number-reel" style="--ui-digit: 4">   10 spans "0".."9"
```

#### Props
- `AnimatedNumber`: `value` (number), `format` (`Intl.NumberFormatOptions`), `locale` (default `en-US`, fixed so SSR matches), `prefix` / `suffix` (static text), `animateOnView` (digits start at 0 and roll when first scrolled into view); all `<span>` props.
- `useCountUp({ end, start = 0, duration = 1400, delay = 0, threshold = 0.4, once = true, disabled })` → `{ ref, value, inView }`. Attach `ref` to the element showing the number; `value` is a float to format yourself.

#### Behaviour
- `Intl.NumberFormat(locale, format).formatToParts(value)` → cells. Digits are keyed by place value (`int-3`, `frac-0`), so growing from 999 to 1,000 rolls the existing digits and only the new thousands digit and separator mount (with a short rise-in).
- Each digit column translates its reel to the new digit: `transform: translateY(calc(var(--ui-digit) * -10%))`.
- Width is stable: tabular figures, one fixed cell per character; symbols come straight from Intl (any locale and currency, including non-Latin digits).
- Reduced motion: digits change instantly (global rule makes the transition 1ms). `useCountUp` jumps straight to `end`.

#### Visual rules
- Inherits font, size and colour from its parent; `line-height: 1.15` per digit line, `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

#### Motion
- Roll: `transform` on `--ui-spring-morph` over `--ui-spring-morph-duration` (550ms). Entering cells: `ui-number-in`, 220ms, rises 0.3em with a 2px blur that clears.
- Count-up: easeOutExpo, 1400ms.

#### Accessibility
- Screen readers read the `ui-number-sr` text; the animated cells are `aria-hidden`. No live region by default — pass `aria-live="polite"` (and `aria-atomic`) only for numbers that should be announced.

#### Acceptance checks
- Changing the value 1234.5 → 1240.75 rolls only the digits that changed; the text width does not jitter.
- Currency symbol and separators stay put; negative values and compact notation (1.2K) render.
- `animateOnView` rolls from 0 only once the number is on screen.

### `ui/components/animated-counter/animated-counter.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { buildNumberCells, localizedDigits, numberText } from './number-parts';

export interface AnimatedNumberProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, 'children'> {
  /** The number to show. Changing it rolls each changed digit to its new value. */
  value: number;
  /** Intl.NumberFormat options: `{ style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }`, `{ notation: 'compact' }`… */
  format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions;
  /** BCP 47 locale. Default `en-US` (fixed, so server and client render the same). */
  locale?: string;
  /** Static text before the number (not animated), e.g. "+". */
  prefix?: string;
  /** Static text after the number (not animated), e.g. " users". */
  suffix?: string;
  /** Start every digit at 0 and roll to the value when the number first scrolls into view. */
  animateOnView?: boolean;
}

/**
 * AnimatedNumber — digits that roll. Each digit is a column of 0–9 that slides to the new digit on
 * the morph spring; the width stays steady (tabular figures, one cell per character) and symbols and
 * separators come from Intl, so any locale or currency works. Reduced motion changes instantly.
 * Screen readers get the plain formatted text.
 */
export const AnimatedNumber = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, AnimatedNumberProps>(function AnimatedNumber(
  { value, format, locale = 'en-US', prefix, suffix, animateOnView = false, className, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, rootRef);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(!animateOnView);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ready) return;
    const el = rootRef.current;
    if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {
      setReady(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (entries.some((e) => e.isIntersecting)) {
          setReady(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.5 },
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [ready]);

  const formatKey = format ? JSON.stringify(format) : '';
  const digits = useMemo(() => localizedDigits(locale), [locale]);
  const { cells, text } = useMemo(() => {
    let parts: Intl.NumberFormatPart[];
    try {
      parts = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, format).formatToParts(value);
    } catch {
      parts = [{ type: 'integer', value: String(value) }];
    }
    return { cells: buildNumberCells(parts, digits), text: numberText(parts) };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- `format` is tracked through formatKey
  }, [value, locale, formatKey, digits]);

  // Cells that were not there on the previous render get an entrance
  const previous = useRef<Set<string> | null>(null);
  const entering = new Set<string>();
  if (previous.current) for (const cell of cells) if (!previous.current.has(cell.key)) entering.add(cell.key);
  useEffect(() => {
    previous.current = new Set(cells.map((c) => c.key));
  });

  return (
    <span ref={ref} className={cn('ui-number', className)} data-ready={ready ? '' : undefined} {...props}>
      <span className="ui-number-sr">{`${prefix ?? ''}${text}${suffix ?? ''}`}</span>
      <span className="ui-number-visual" aria-hidden="true">
        {prefix ? <span className="ui-number-symbol">{prefix}</span> : null}
        {cells.map((cell) =>
          cell.kind === 'digit' ? (
            <span key={cell.key} className="ui-number-digit" data-enter={entering.has(cell.key) ? '' : undefined}>
              <span className="ui-number-reel" style={{ '--ui-digit': ready ? cell.digit : 0 } as CSSProperties}>
                {digits.map((d, i) => (
                  <span key={i}>{d}</span>
                ))}
              </span>
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span key={cell.key} className="ui-number-symbol" data-type={cell.type} data-enter={entering.has(cell.key) ? '' : undefined}>
              {cell.text}
            </span>
          ),
        )}
        {suffix ? <span className="ui-number-symbol">{suffix}</span> : null}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/animated-counter/number-parts.ts`

```ts
/* Pure helpers behind AnimatedNumber: turn Intl parts into stable "cells". */

export interface DigitCell {
  kind: 'digit';
  /** Stable across value changes: the digit keeps its place from the decimal point. */
  key: string;
  /** 0–9: which row of the reel to show. */
  digit: number;
}

export interface SymbolCell {
  kind: 'symbol';
  key: string;
  text: string;
  /** The Intl part type: currency, group, decimal, minusSign, percentSign, compact, literal… */
  type: string;
}

export type NumberCell = DigitCell | SymbolCell;

const digitCache = new Map<string, string[]>();

/** The ten digits in the locale's numbering system ("0".."9" for en, "٠".."٩" for ar-EG). */
export function localizedDigits(locale: string): string[] {
  const cached = digitCache.get(locale);
  if (cached) return cached;
  let digits: string[];
  try {
    const nf = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { useGrouping: false, maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
    digits = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => nf.format(i));
  } catch {
    digits = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => String(i));
  }
  digitCache.set(locale, digits);
  return digits;
}

/**
 * Split formatted parts into cells. Digits are keyed by place value (`int-3` is the thousands digit,
 * `frac-0` the first decimal), so when 999 becomes 1,000 the existing digits roll and only the new
 * ones appear. Separators and symbols are keyed by their part type.
 */
export function buildNumberCells(parts: readonly Intl.NumberFormatPart[], digits: readonly string[]): NumberCell[] {
  const integerLength = parts.reduce((n, p) => (p.type === 'integer' ? n + Array.from(p.value).length : n), 0);
  const cells: NumberCell[] = [];
  const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
  let integerIndex = 0;
  let fractionIndex = 0;

  const pushSymbol = (type: string, text: string) => {
    counts[type] = (counts[type] ?? -1) + 1;
    cells.push({ kind: 'symbol', key: `${type}-${counts[type]}`, text, type });
  };

  for (const part of parts) {
    if (part.type === 'integer' || part.type === 'fraction') {
      for (const char of Array.from(part.value)) {
        const digit = digits.indexOf(char);
        if (part.type === 'integer') {
          const place = integerLength - 1 - integerIndex++;
          if (digit === -1) pushSymbol('integer', char);
          else cells.push({ kind: 'digit', key: `int-${place}`, digit });
        } else {
          const index = fractionIndex++;
          if (digit === -1) pushSymbol('fraction', char);
          else cells.push({ kind: 'digit', key: `frac-${index}`, digit });
        }
      }
    } else if (part.type === 'group') {
      // Keyed by the place of the digit that follows it
      cells.push({ kind: 'symbol', key: `group-${integerLength - 1 - integerIndex}`, text: part.value, type: 'group' });
    } else {
      pushSymbol(part.type, part.value);
    }
  }
  return cells;
}

/** The plain formatted text, for screen readers. */
export function numberText(parts: readonly Intl.NumberFormatPart[]): string {
  return parts.map((p) => p.value).join('');
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-count-up.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export interface UseCountUpOptions {
  /** Final value. Changing it later tweens from the current value. */
  end: number;
  /** Where the count starts. Default 0. */
  start?: number;
  /** Tween length in ms. Default 1400. */
  duration?: number;
  /** Wait before starting, in ms. Default 0. */
  delay?: number;
  /** Fraction of the element that must be visible to start. Default 0.4. */
  threshold?: number;
  /** Count once, the first time it scrolls into view. When false it resets and replays on every entry. Default true. */
  once?: boolean;
  /** Skip the animation and return `end`. */
  disabled?: boolean;
}

const easeOutExpo = (t: number) => (t >= 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t));

/**
 * Count from `start` to `end` when the element scrolls into view.
 * Attach `ref` to the element that shows the number; `value` is a float, so format it
 * (e.g. with Intl.NumberFormat and tabular-nums). Reduced motion jumps straight to `end`.
 *   const { ref, value } = useCountUp<HTMLSpanElement>({ end: 12480 });
 */
export function useCountUp<T extends Element = HTMLElement>({
  end,
  start = 0,
  duration = 1400,
  delay = 0,
  threshold = 0.4,
  once = true,
  disabled = false,
}: UseCountUpOptions) {
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);
  const [value, setValue] = useState(disabled ? end : start);
  const current = useRef(disabled ? end : start);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (disabled) return;
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {
      setInView(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            setInView(true);
            if (once) observer.disconnect();
          } else if (!once) {
            setInView(false);
          }
        }
      },
      { threshold },
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [disabled, once, threshold]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (disabled) {
      current.current = end;
      setValue(end);
      return;
    }
    if (!inView) {
      if (!once) {
        current.current = start;
        setValue(start);
      }
      return;
    }
    const reduced = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    if (reduced || duration <= 0) {
      current.current = end;
      setValue(end);
      return;
    }
    const from = current.current;
    let frame = 0;
    let began: number | null = null;
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      if (began === null) began = now;
      const t = Math.min(1, (now - began) / duration);
      const next = from + (end - from) * easeOutExpo(t);
      current.current = next;
      setValue(next);
      if (t < 1) frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }, delay);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
  }, [disabled, inView, end, start, duration, delay, once]);

  return { ref, value, inView };
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/animated-counter.css`

```css
/* Animated counter --------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-number
     .ui-number-sr       the plain text for assistive tech
     .ui-number-visual   aria-hidden row of cells
       .ui-number-digit > .ui-number-reel (--ui-digit: 0–9) > span × 10
       .ui-number-symbol  currency, separators, signs, suffixes
   Each digit column is one line tall and clips its reel; the reel slides on the morph spring.
   Reduced motion: the global rule in motion.css makes the slide instant.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-number {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  .ui-number-sr {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .ui-number-visual {
    display: inline-block;
    line-height: 1.15;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .ui-number-digit,
  .ui-number-symbol {
    display: inline-block;
    height: 1.15em;
    vertical-align: top;
  }
  .ui-number-symbol { white-space: pre; }

  .ui-number-digit { overflow: hidden; }

  .ui-number-reel {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    transform: translateY(calc(var(--ui-digit, 0) * -10%));
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph);
    will-change: transform;
  }
  .ui-number-reel > span {
    display: block;
    height: 1.15em;
    text-align: center;
  }

  /* Cells that join when the number grows (999 → 1,000) */
  .ui-number-digit[data-enter],
  .ui-number-symbol[data-enter] {
    animation: ui-number-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  }
}

@keyframes ui-number-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0.3em); filter: blur(var(--ui-blur-subtle)); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; }
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```


## Usage

**Live revenue counter** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/animated-counter/revenue.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AnimatedNumber } from '@/ui/components/animated-counter';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const orders = [49, 129.5, 24, 349, 79.99, 199, 18.75, 640];

/** A live revenue ticker: a new order lands every couple of seconds and the digits roll. */
export default function LiveRevenue() {
  const [revenue, setRevenue] = useState(128430.5);
  const [live, setLive] = useState(true);
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!live) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setTick((t) => t + 1);
      setRevenue((r) => Math.round((r + orders[(Math.floor(r) + 3) % orders.length]) * 100) / 100);
    }, 2200);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [live]);

  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-start gap-3">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Revenue today
        <Badge variant={live ? 'success' : 'secondary'} live={live} dot={!live}>
          {live ? 'Live' : 'Paused'}
        </Badge>
      </div>
      <AnimatedNumber
        value={revenue}
        format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }}
        className="text-4xl font-medium tracking-tight"
      />
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{tick === 0 ? 'Waiting for the next order…' : `${tick} new ${tick === 1 ? 'order' : 'orders'} since you opened this page`}</p>
      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setLive((v) => !v)}>
        <Icon name={live ? 'loader' : 'refresh-cw'} />
        {live ? 'Pause' : 'Resume'}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```
